wait-board.title: Objective
wait-board.text: Wait for the board to leave

lab.title: Objective
lab.text: The halls are black past the lamps. G is the light. F opens the phone. Find the lab door.

lurk.title: It is loose
lurk.text: It is moving in the dark. Keep the light up.

hunt.title: Shoot it
hunt.text: It is coming. Do not let it reach you.

vat.title: It breaks
vat.text: It is running for the vat.

return.title: Get upstairs
return.text: The elevator is the way back.

mirror.title: Look
mirror.text: The hall bathroom. Find the mirror.

home.title: Get home
home.text: East on the sidewalk. Do not go back inside.

shove.title: Shove
shove.text: They will not move. V knocks them back.

sidearm.name: Phone
sidearm.note: Company line. F opens the screen. The sidearm has to be holstered.

sidearm.name: Sidearm
sidearm.note: Company issue. Draw it from the weapon slot.

clearance.name: Phone
clearance.note: Company line. F opens the screen. The sidearm has to be holstered.

clearance.name: Sidearm
clearance.note: Company issue. Draw it from the weapon slot.

b3.name: B3 clearance
b3.note: The cab stopped on its own.

changed.name: Sidearm
changed.note: The hand still closes around it.

changed.name: Still thinking
changed.note: The vat took the body. The voice stayed.

apex.title: Level Complete
apex.text: Apex Peak is done. Continue into B3.

b3.title: Level Complete
b3.text: B3 incident is done. Pierce is not the man who walked in.

return.title: Level Complete
return.text: The mirror is sure. Whatever this is, it is him. Continue. The desk is still waiting.

home.title: Level Complete
home.text: The tower is behind him. The street already knows.
